name: R006-armaldo-knock-off-low-target
why: Challenge 4 (full AI). The opponent leads Armaldo (set 513: Iron Tail, Ancient Power, Brick Break, Knock Off; speed 65). The player leads Meganium (set 541; speed 100) and uses Substitute every turn: each Substitute costs a quarter of its HP and Armaldo's best move breaks it, so after about four Substitutes (Leftovers slows it a little) Meganium is below 30 percent at the start of a turn. Then the AI scores Knock Off through AI_CV_KnockOff: target HP below 30 ends the handler at zero, the runCvKnockOff early-return block. Golem 498 (Substitute in the same slot) and Medicham 469 (Endure in the same slot) follow with the same step.
